premise: The capsule's crew are taking a picture of the base from orbit, so in the long night Leo lights up the crew rover and the greenhouse: two eyes and a smile for anyone looking down.
inspiration: Signal fires lit on hilltops to greet friends far away, a folk custom, turned: a smile made of lamps, for friends in the sky.
lesson: A little effort can send a big smile a long way.

en-US.title: A Smile from Orbit
en-US.text: {canvas:nightfall} In the long Moon night, a {capsule:enter} {capsule:float loop 0.3} capsule was passing high overhead, and its crew wanted a picture of the base. {man:enter} Leo had a funny idea. {man:face happy} [mischievously] Why not give them something to smile at? He sent the big {crew-rover:enter} crew rover rolling out onto the plain. {crew-rover:live hold} {sfx:lights} Its two headlights blazed on, like two bright eyes. Then he loped over to the {greenhouse:enter} greenhouse. {man:go to greenhouse} {greenhouse:live} Click! Its grow lights came on, and the round dome glowed like a wide, happy smile. {man:hop} [playfully] Two eyes. One smile. From high above, the base looked like a big friendly face. {crew-rover:pulse} {capsule:live} Up in the sky, the capsule turned its wings… {sfx:click} and snapped a picture. {man:live} Leo checked his wrist. A message had come back. Just one word: Smiling! {man:face happy} {man:wobble x2} [laughs] Leo laughed out loud. {greenhouse:glow 0.5} [warmly] And down on the Moon, the big bright face kept on smiling back.

es-ES.title: Una sonrisa desde la órbita
es-ES.text: {canvas:nightfall} En la larga noche lunar, una {capsule:enter} {capsule:float loop 0.3} cápsula pasaba muy alto, y su tripulación quería una foto de la base. {man:enter} Leo tuvo una idea divertida. {man:face happy} [mischievously] ¿Y si les daba algo para sonreír? Mandó al gran {crew-rover:enter} rover de tripulación a la llanura. {crew-rover:live hold} {sfx:lights} Sus dos faros se encendieron, como dos ojos brillantes. Luego fue dando saltos hasta el {greenhouse:enter} invernadero. {man:go to greenhouse} {greenhouse:live} ¡Clic! Se encendieron sus luces, y la cúpula redonda brilló como una gran sonrisa. {man:hop} [playfully] Dos ojos. Una sonrisa. Desde allí arriba, la base parecía una cara grande y simpática. {crew-rover:pulse} {capsule:live} En el cielo, la cápsula giró sus alas… {sfx:click} e hizo una foto. {man:live} Leo miró su muñeca. Había llegado un mensaje. Solo una palabra: ¡Sonriendo! {man:face happy} {man:wobble x2} [laughs] Leo se rió a carcajadas. {greenhouse:glow 0.5} [warmly] Y aquí abajo, en la Luna, la gran cara luminosa siguió sonriendo.
